narr: An upper-level trough combined with strong instability (SB CAPE of 2000+ J/KG) and high moisture content (PWAT of 1.7+ inches) to result in the development of strong to severe thunderstorms across portions of Riverside and Imperial Counties during the afternoon and early evening hours. A complex of thunderstorms originating from southwest Arizona moved westward through Riverside while intensifying in the process. Another complex of storms then developed near the international border and affected Imperial County.
ev: South Boundary Road of Joshua Tree National Park was closed due to flooding. All visitors were evacuated from the southern portion the park. No damages or injuries were reported.
Pinto Basin Road in Joshua Tree National Park was closed due to washes running over road. The water was estimated to be running 1 foot in depth over the road. No damages or injuries were reported.
Ogilby Rd was closed due to flood debris and a road washout. Timing estimated from radar. No injuries were reported.
Box Canyon Road near I-10 was closed due to flooding. Vehicle with two occupants was stranded in the flood water. No damages or injuries were reported.
